chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim (may God be pleased with him) narrated that his father narrated to him, from his father Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Trimming the nails and shaving the moustache from one Friday to the next provides immunity from leprosy.

key_terms.مِنْ جُمْعَةٍ إِلَى جُمْعَةٍ: From one Friday to the next (weekly)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling and benefit of trimming nails and shaving the moustache weekly?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) linking the weekly grooming practice of trimming nails and shaving the moustache to physical immunity from leprosy (*al-jadham*). This hadith exemplifies the Shia emphasis on *fitrah* (natural disposition), where routine physical purification serves as a means for spiritual and bodily protection, reflecting the holistic view of health in Islamic tradition. The specific timeframe 'from Friday to Friday' underscores the importance of maintaining ritual cleanliness (*taharah*) in preparation for the weekly congregational prayers.
